name: PSK Reporter
author: HamDash
description: Who is hearing whom, from pskreporter.info, on a map you can filter

watch.label: Watch
watch.help: A callsign to follow both ways - who is hearing it and what it is hearing - or a four-character grid square for everything heard there. Blank uses your own grid from Settings.

basemap.label: Base map
basemap.help: Built-in needs no network and no account. The tile options need a connection.

borders.label: Country borders
borders.help: Drawn on the built-in base map. Tile base maps bring their own.

subdivisions.label: States and provinces
subdivisions.help: Internal boundaries, on the built-in base map. Natural Earth publishes these for Australia, Brazil, Canada, China, India, Indonesia, Russia, South Africa and the United States; elsewhere there is nothing to draw.

projection.label: Projection
projection.help: Azimuthal puts you in the middle and makes every bearing a straight line out from your station. It only works with the built-in base map: no tile service publishes tiles in that projection.

tile_url.label: Custom tile URL
tile_url.help: Only for 'custom tiles'. A template like https://tile.example.com/{z}/{x}/{y}.png?key=YOURKEY. Use your own provider and key.

tile_attribution.label: Custom tile credit
tile_attribution.help: Shown in the map corner. Most providers require this.

paths.label: Draw the path
paths.help: A line from transmitter to receiver for each report. Off leaves just the dots, which is easier to read when there are hundreds.

owm_key.label: OpenWeatherMap key
owm_key.help: Only needed for the cloud layer. Free tier is plenty. Without a key the cloud layer is hidden rather than broken.
